components.name: Curled bird form
components.description: A broad curled bird-like outline faces right with a short horizontal beak and a lower curved wing or tail. Exclude the detached leaf-shaped element; the exact bird anatomy remains to be confirmed.

components.name: Pointed leaf shape
components.description: A detached teardrop-shaped leaf has a rounded lower-left end and a pointed upper-right tip, without an internal vein. Exclude the larger bird-like form.
